task: Fix server-backed authority_job_status so protected job verdict/status GET requests send the configured customer API key.
outcome: Running authority_job_status against staging no longer fails with 401 when the same configured customer key can read the server endpoint directly; if no runner receipt or 2-host quorum exists, the command still reports blocked/fullAuthorityDone=false.
facts: Developer feedback on 2026-06-19 showed direct GET with the customer key succeeded while CLI authority_job_status received 401.
The CLI AuthorityClient get helper currently sends only Accept headers for all GET calls.
Policy discovery GET /v1/authority/policy should remain keyless.
fullAuthorityDone still requires a verified native gate_decision receipt plus satisfied independent-host reconciliation.
constraints: Do not modify server bundle generation in the public CLI repo.
Do not send customer API keys to policy discovery.
Do not change receipt verification semantics or quorum thresholds.
Do not read or modify generated senior key/env files in the repo root.
